data.title: Tunisia says summer of 2026 hottest on record
data.description: TUNIS - Tunisia’s summer this year was its hottest on record, the country’s weather authority said on Tuesday, following multiple heatwaves, water shortages and power cuts.

data.title: Questions mount about Trump Jr’s Russian-financed wedding
data.description: WASHINGTON - A Republican US senator has called for Donald Trump Jr to be subpoenaed over a Russian oligarch close to Vladimir Putin helping bankroll lavish celebrations for the president’s son’s wedding.

data.title: Trump to use UN speech to defend Iran war
data.description: UNITED NATIONS - US President Donald Trump was preparing to use his an address to the United Nations to argue that the war with Iran prevented Tehran from obtaining a nuclear weapon and to tout what he sees as progress toward peace and a global order increasingly aligned with American interests, according to a White House official.

data.title: Kanjutha’s MMA gold a landmark moment
data.description: Thailand struck gold in unfamiliar territory on Tuesday as Kanjutha Phattaraboonsorn choked back tears to deliver a landmark mixed martial arts triumph, headlining a golden day for the Thai contingent at the 20th Asian Games Aichi-Nagoya 2026.

data.title: ONE Championship: Antonia Prifti wants Phetjeeja title shot rebooked after debut win
data.description: Greece’s Antonia Prifti wants her cancelled title shot against Phetjeeja Lukjaoporongtom rebooked after winning her ONE Championship debut.

data.title: No fear from Thai footballers as they target Japan
data.description: Thailand’s men’s football team close out their Asian Games group campaign against the host nation tonight, chasing not just pride but top spot, and Auttapon Sangthong is promising that the side, unburdened by pressure, will go toe-to-toe with the tournament favourites.

data.title: Thai badminton star challenges doping ruling
data.description: Thailand’s rising badminton star Pitchamon Opatniputh has moved swiftly to challenge her positive drug test, requesting an analysis of her B sample after becoming the first confirmed doping case of the Asian Games in Japan.

data.title: India’s women retain Asian Games cricket crown
data.description: NAGOYA, Japan - India’s dominant women retained their Asian Games cricket crown in style on Tuesday as an Afghan cyclist who once disguised herself as a man won a “special” silver.

data.title: Serial killer Aem Cyanide gets fifth death sentence
data.description: The Criminal Court on Tuesday sentenced Sararat Rangsiwuthaporn, aka Aem Cyanide, 39, to death for fatally poisoning her creditor in Phetchaburi province in August 2022.

data.title: ONE Championship unveils AI-powered rankings after overhaul
data.description: ONE Championship has unveiled AI-powered rankings for four Muay Thai divisions, restoring an official pecking order after removing its previous lists at the end of 2025.

data.title: Thai Union CEO Thiraphong Chansiri wins Global Seafood Alliance lifetime achievement award
data.description: BANGKOK, September 22, 2026 – Thiraphong Chansiri, President & CEO of Thai Union Group PCL, received the Wallace R. Stevens Lifetime Achievement Award from the Global Seafood Alliance (GSA), recognizing more than three decades of leadership that helped transform Thai Union and change the seafood industry.

data.title: Student opens fire outside school in Turkey, 11 pupils wounded
data.description: ANKARA — A student ​opened fire in front of their high school in Turkey's ​western province of Manisa early ‌on Tuesday, wounding at least 11 other pupils, Justice Minister Akin Gurlek said.

data.title: Missing F-35 fighter parts 'not sensitive', says Australian minister
data.description: SYDNEY — Missing F-35 fighter parts diverted from Australia to Hong Kong are not "sensitive", Defence Minister Richard Marles said Tuesday, confirming Canberra was helping to investigate the incident.

data.title: Iran ready to reopen Strait of Hormuz if US eases military pressure and lifts blockade
data.description: NEW YORK — Iran can reopen the Strait of Hormuz ​within seven days ‌if the United States eases military pressure and lifts its blockade on Iranian ports, a senior Iranian official told Reuters on Tuesday.

data.title: City Hall pledges quick reopening of two children's museums in Bangkok
data.description: The Bangkok Metropolitan Administration (BMA) has promised to quickly find a new team to operate and reopen two childen's museums being forced to close next week by financial red tape.

data.title: Fishing boat sinks off Chon Buri, 3 dead, 4 missing
data.description: A fishing boat carrying 22 crew members has sunk off the coast of Chon Buri, with three people confirmed dead, four missing and 15 rescued, marine authorities said.
